site.title: AI Engineer Cookbook
site.indexDescription: A course for developers who want to become AI engineers: from the first API call to RAG, evals and agents. Weekly chapters, practice and quizzes.
site.planDescription: AI engineer course plan for developers: what to learn each week, four portfolio projects, DeepSeek and Ollama models, 8–10 hours a week for 4–5 months.
site.ogImageAlt: AI Engineer Cookbook: LLM APIs, RAG, evals, agents
site.indexIntro: Chapters in reading order: number = week.order. The overall plan and schedule are on the [{planLabel}]({planPath}) page.
site.reviewDescription: Quiz questions from every chapter that you answered wrong, revealed without trying, or marked “Didn't know”.
site.reviewIntro: This page collects the quiz questions from every chapter where the answer was wrong, revealed without an attempt, or marked “Didn't know”. Open a question, reread the theory next to it and press “Try again”: once you answer it right, the question leaves the list.
site.untranslatedDescription: {title}: this page is not translated into English yet; the original is in Russian.
site.untranslatedNote: This page has not been translated into English yet. [Read the original in Russian]({href}).

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.description: What data the AI Engineer Cookbook keeps: progress in your browser, and after signing in with Google or GitHub only the account ID and the progress. No ads.
privacy.intro: In short: we keep only your progress, show no ads and share no data with third parties.
privacy.contactPlaceholder: the contact will appear here before sign-in goes live

withoutAccount.heading: Without signing in
blocks: Your progress is stored only in your browser and is not sent anywhere.

signIn.heading: Signing in with Google or GitHub
blocks: Signing in is optional: it only makes your progress available on all your devices. From Google or GitHub we get only the account ID, with no e-mail, name or photo, and keep it together with your progress. This data is used only for signing in and is not shared with third parties.

cookies.heading: Cookies
blocks: Cookies appear only when you sign in, to keep you signed in. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

analytics.heading: Statistics
blocks: We count visits anonymously and without cookies, to see which chapters people read.

rights.heading: Deleting your data
blocks: You can delete the account at any time: open the account menu at the top right (on a phone it is at the bottom of the main menu) and press “{deleteLabel}”. The account and the progress on the server are deleted right away.
